column1: # test.census.tsv — per-file wall-clock time, measured 2026-09-21 on v4/test-split.
# Each row is ONE bare-metal `bun test <file>` invocation, timed alone (not inside
# the shared `bun test <list-of-files>` process the normal `test`/`test:full`
# scripts use). That means every row pays its own process startup + module load +
# fixture setup that a single combined run amortises — these numbers are an UPPER
# BOUND on each file's share of a real run, and they sum to MORE than a real run's
# wall clock (measured: 1068.74s summed here vs 712.87s for one combined run of
# the same 66 files/1022 tests on main at 63e1db0). Use this file to ORDER and
# BUCKET files by relative cost, not to predict absolute suite time.
# Columns: path(relative to app/server)  seconds  exit_code  pass_count  fail_count
# Regenerate with ./test-census.sh (~18 minutes: runs every *.test.ts file under
# test/, plus ../cli.test.ts, as its own bun test invocation). Re-run after adding,
# removing, or materially changing test files so test.order.ts's ordering and
# test.fast.txt's split stay honest. A file with NO entry here (new since the last
# census) is not silently ignored: test.order.ts warns on stderr and falls back to
# the old name-based isSlow() heuristic for that file only, biased slow so an
# unmeasured file can never masquerade as fast; test:fast excludes it until it has
